collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: A villager draws a long, looping pattern in the wet sand with a stick.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (subject) draws a long, looping pattern in the wet sand with a stick. The pattern stretches nearly to the rocks before (subject) runs out of ideas.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (subject) draws a long, looping pattern in the wet sand with a stick. The tide slowly erases it, and (subject) watches without regret.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (subject) draws a long, looping pattern in the wet sand with a stick. (friend) adds a matching pattern beside it, and the two meet in the middle.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: (subject) draws a long, looping pattern in the wet sand with a stick. Small crabs wander across it, leaving tracks of their own.
